cards.question: What is the prognostic value of CPET anaerobic threshold (AT) before major surgery?
cards.answer: An AT <11 mL/kg/min predicts increased postoperative cardiopulmonary morbidity and 30/90-day mortality after major non-cardiac surgery; 11–14 mL/kg/min is intermediate risk and >14 mL/kg/min low risk (Older 1993; POM-HR).

cards.question: When should elective non-cardiac surgery be deferred after PCI?
cards.answer: Elective non-cardiac surgery should be delayed at least 1 month after PCI regardless of stent type. Beyond this, whether to continue or interrupt dual antiplatelet therapy is a multidisciplinary (heart team) decision balancing individual thrombotic risk against surgical bleeding risk (ESC Non-Cardiac Surgery 2022).

cards.question: How is the Revised Cardiac Risk Index (Lee) interpreted?
cards.answer: Six predictors (high-risk surgery, IHD, heart failure, cerebrovascular disease, insulin-treated diabetes, creatinine >170 µmol/L): 0 ≈ 0.4%, 1 ≈ 1%, 2 ≈ 2.4%, ≥3 ≈ 5.4% risk of a major cardiac event at 30 days.
